svg.title: Linux kernel path of a ROS 2 UDP datagram: TX and RX
svg.text: Linux kernel path of one RTPS/UDP datagram
names checked against /proc/kallsyms (Linux 7.0) · driver example: r8169 · ⌁ = tracepoint · dashed = user/kernel
copy into new skb (no page pool) · eth_type_trans
Notes: inlined helpers (e.g. __udp_queue_rcv_skb) are not in kallsyms; non-list RX uses
__netif_receive_skb_one_core → ip_rcv. Function names change between kernel versions.
